description: Implement the FastAPI JSON web tier and the CloudFront signing module, plus the local-dev config convention and the web-tier launch artifacts. Depends only on the resource contracts (bucket/table/queue names, env var names) from DESIGN + context.json; does not require FEAT-002/004 code. Grounded in DESIGN.md sections: FastAPI web tier (all routes + exception table + input validation + invariant ownership), CloudFront + signed-cookie playback, Signing-key caching, Local-dev approach, IAM web-tier role (grants the app relies on), video_id derived once. Carries MUST-FIX: signer uses CF_KEY_PAIR_ID (the PUBLIC KEY id); startup secret read fails /health until present; local play-url returns a URL to the local rewritten-playlist endpoint whose segment lines are absolute CloudFront signed URLs.
steps: Implement api/main.py (FastAPI) reading env INPUT_BUCKET, OUTPUT_BUCKET, TABLE_NAME, ARTIFACT_BUCKET, CF_KEY_SECRET_ARN, CF_DOMAIN, CF_KEY_PAIR_ID, MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES (default 2147483648), PLAYBACK_MODE/region. Routes: POST /videos (video_id=uuid4().hex; sanitize original_filename per DESIGN Finding 7 -> safe_filename; s3.upload_fileobj(file.file, INPUT_BUCKET, 'input/{video_id}/{safe_filename}', ExtraArgs={'Metadata':{'video-id':video_id},'ContentType':file.content_type}); enforce size cap on Content-Length AND by aborting the stream if running bytes exceed the cap; then update_item status=Queued, gsi_pk='VIDEO', created_at, title, original_filename; on update_item failure do a best-effort compensating s3.delete_object of the just-uploaded key then 502). GET /videos (GSI Query gsi_pk='VIDEO', ScanIndexForward=False, Limit=100 -- no scan). GET /videos/{video_id} (get_item; 'Item' absent -> 404; ResourceNotFoundException -> 500). GET /videos/{video_id}/play-url (validate ^[0-9a-f]{32}$; if Ready: production sets the 3 CloudFront signed cookies scoped to /media/{video_id}/* (6h, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=None, Path=/media/{video_id}/) and returns the playlist URL; local mode returns a URL to this API's rewritten-playlist endpoint whose segment lines are absolute CloudFront signed URLs; else 409 + {status}). DELETE /videos/{video_id} (delete_item then ListObjectsV2+DeleteObjects on input/{id}/ and output/{id}/). GET /health (shallow 200, but 503 if the signing key failed to load -- see signing). Run as an unprivileged service on port 8000.

Implement api/signing.py: a FastAPI lifespan/startup hook fetches the private PEM from Secrets Manager (CF_KEY_SECRET_ARN) ONCE, parses it to an rsa.RSAPrivateKey, caches it with a 12h TTL refresh. If the startup read fails, mark the app unhealthy so GET /health returns 503 (ALB pulls the target) rather than serving unsignable play-urls. Provide sign_cookies(resource, ttl) and sign_url(url, ttl) using the SAME key, per-resource custom policy, and TTL; both set CloudFront-Key-Pair-Id to CF_KEY_PAIR_ID (the PUBLIC KEY id). Add the local rewritten-playlist helper: fetch the .m3u8, rewrite each segment line to an absolute CloudFront signed URL, return the rewritten playlist (local-dev-only, gated by playback mode).

Per-operation exception handling exactly per the DESIGN exception table: match botocore.exceptions.ClientError on error.response['Error']['Code'] so AccessDenied is never masked as 404; validation -> 400; upload/ClientError -> 502 (log w/ video_id); get_item absent -> 404; ResourceNotFoundException -> 500; play-url-not-Ready -> 409; secrets read failure -> 500 and never log the key. A FastAPI exception handler maps unexpected errors to 500 with the video_id in the log. No bare except anywhere. CORS: allow the CloudFront origin + the two localhost dev origins explicitly (not *), allow_credentials=True.

Add the local-dev config convention: frontend/config.local.json is created in FEAT-004, but document in api/README-or-comments the loopback run `uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000` reading the same env names. Add api/requirements.txt (fastapi, uvicorn[standard], gunicorn, boto3, cryptography, python-multipart). Add api/user-data.sh (create appuser, write systemd EnvironmentFile /etc/video-web.env from CDK-injected env, start the service) and api/video-web.service (gunicorn with uvicorn workers, bind 127.0.0.1:8000 or the private iface, User=appuser, logs to CloudWatch group /video/web).

Add api/tests/test_api.py and api/tests/test_signing.py (pytest, boto3 via botocore.stub.Stubber, fastapi.testclient.TestClient): video_id/key/metadata construction; original_filename sanitization; GSI Query builder; exception mapping per ClientError code (AccessDenied != 404); input validation (content-type must start with video/, size cap, path-param regex); signed cookie + signed URL generation assert the scoped Resource path, the 6h TTL, and CloudFront-Key-Pair-Id == CF_KEY_PAIR_ID; /health returns 503 when the signing key is unloaded. Mock the key with a locally generated test RSA key.
acceptance_criteria: pytest api/tests passes including the signer tests asserting CloudFront-Key-Pair-Id uses CF_KEY_PAIR_ID and the /media/{video_id}/* scoped policy with 6h TTL.
ruff check . passes, python -c 'import main' and 'import signing' succeed (with stub env set).
uvicorn boot smoke: `uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000` starts and `curl -f 127.0.0.1:8000/health` returns 200 with a valid stubbed signing key (and 503 when the key is absent).
No bare except in api/*.py; ClientError is matched on the error code.
verification: cd projects/video-streaming-app/api && pip install -r requirements.txt pytest ruff

set stub env (INPUT_BUCKET/OUTPUT_BUCKET/TABLE_NAME/ARTIFACT_BUCKET/CF_KEY_SECRET_ARN/CF_DOMAIN/CF_KEY_PAIR_ID) then start uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 in the background, curl -f 127.0.0.1:8000/health, stop it
findings:
DONE + VERIFIED. api/ package: main.py, signing.py, requirements.txt, user-data.sh, video-web.service, README.md, conftest.py, tests/{test_api,test_signing}.py. Verification: ruff clean; pytest 25/25 pass; uvicorn /health smoke returns 200 with a (stub) signing key and 503 without. Committed as 6f08a44 feat(api) on branch video-streaming-hardening.

MUST-FIX carry-forwards implemented here:
- HIGH_cf_public_key_id: signer sets CloudFront-Key-Pair-Id = CF_KEY_PAIR_ID (the PUBLIC KEY id) for BOTH signed cookies and signed URLs; asserted in test_signing. FEAT-005 MUST inject CF_KEY_PAIR_ID = public_key.public_key_id into the web-tier env (launch-template EnvironmentFile), NOT the key-group id.
- MED_signing_key_startup: FastAPI lifespan loads the private PEM from Secrets Manager ONCE (12h TTL refresh); /health returns 503 until loaded so the ALB pulls unhealthy targets. Deploy order documented in api/README.md: cdk deploy -> aws secretsmanager put-secret-value -> ASG replaces initial unhealthy instances. (FEAT-006 runbook should repeat this.)
- NIT_local_playlist: in PLAYBACK_MODE=signed-url, GET /videos/{id}/play-url returns a URL to THIS API's own rewritten-playlist endpoint (GET /videos/{id}/playlist.m3u8), whose segment lines are absolute CloudFront signed URLs (signing.rewrite_playlist). Production (cookie mode) sets the 3 signed cookies scoped to /media/{id}/* (6h, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=None, Path=/media/{id}/).
- NIT_env_injection: user-data.sh writes /etc/video-web.env from @@PLACEHOLDER@@ refs the CDK must substitute (FEAT-005), same var names the app reads locally.

EXACT ENV VAR NAMES the web tier reads (FEAT-005 launch template must set all):
  INPUT_BUCKET, OUTPUT_BUCKET, TABLE_NAME, ARTIFACT_BUCKET (optional for web),
  CF_KEY_SECRET_ARN (ARN of video/cf-signing-key secret),
  CF_DOMAIN (the single CloudFront distribution domain, no scheme),
  CF_KEY_PAIR_ID (= cloudfront.PublicKey public_key_id),
  PLAYBACK_MODE ('cookie' in prod [default], 'signed-url' only for local dev),
  AWS_REGION (us-east-1), MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES (default 2147483648).
  CF_SIGNING_KEY_FILE is LOCAL-DEV-ONLY (reads PEM from a file instead of Secrets Manager); it MUST NOT be set on deployed instances. user-data.sh deliberately omits it.

CONTRACTS FEAT-004 (SPA) + FEAT-005 (CDK) rely on:
- API routes/shapes: POST /videos (multipart 'file' + optional 'title' form field) -> {video_id, status:'Queued'}; GET /videos -> {videos:[...]} newest-first via GSI by-status-created (gsi_pk='VIDEO', ScanIndexForward=False, Limit=100, no scan); GET /videos/{id} -> the item or 404; GET /videos/{id}/play-url -> {play_url, mode:'cookie'|'signed-url'} (+Set-Cookie in cookie mode) or 409 {detail:{status}} when not Ready; DELETE /videos/{id} -> {deleted}. /health shallow 200 (503 if key unloaded).
- DynamoDB item attrs written at upload: video_id(S), status(S)='Queued', gsi_pk(S)='VIDEO', created_at(S ISO-8601), title(S), original_filename(S, verbatim unsanitized). update_item only (never put_item). S3 key = input/{video_id}/{safe_filename}; metadata x-amz-meta-video-id={video_id}.
- Port 8000. gunicorn uvicorn workers. video-web.service binds 0.0.0.0:8000 (ALB connects to the instance's private IP; web-sg admits 8000 only from alb-sg per FEAT-001, private subnet, no public IP). ExecStart uses /opt/video-web/.venv/bin/gunicorn. CloudWatch log group /video/web (FEAT-005 must create it; service logs to journald->CloudWatch).
- CORS: explicit origins only (https://<CF_DOMAIN>, http://127.0.0.1:5500, http://localhost:5500), allow_credentials=True. The SPA local static server should bind 127.0.0.1:5500 to match.

FEAT-005 VPC-origin SG (MED_vpc_origin_sg): NOT verified in FEAT-003 (belongs to FEAT-005). FEAT-005 must still confirm cloudfront.VpcOrigin exists in the installed aws-cdk-lib (FEAT-001 verified 2.274.0), pin ALB + VPC-origin to the same explicit private-subnet set, wire the private-subnet-CIDR ingress TCP 80 on alb-sg (FEAT-001 already wired it), and confirm on synth.

DEPENDENCY NOTE: api/requirements.txt pins httpx (starlette TestClient / fastapi.testclient needs it) alongside fastapi, uvicorn[standard], gunicorn, boto3, cryptography, python-multipart. The resolved starlette emits a StarletteDeprecationWarning suggesting 'httpx2'; httpx works and the smoke/tests pass -- harmless, do not act on it unless a future starlette hard-requires httpx2.

TEST/LINT TOOLING: ruff rule set here is broad (BLE001, B008, G201, S*, UP*) picked up with NO package-level config (same as worker/iac). Used Annotated[UploadFile, File()] / Annotated[str, Form()] to avoid B008, LOG.exception (not .error+exc_info) for G201, datetime.UTC for UP017. Tests add api/ to sys.path via api/conftest.py (also sets dummy AWS creds + the stub env so `import main` works offline).
